title: Grilled Chicken Skewers with Jagged Tangy Sauce
description: A flavorful and spicy dish featuring chicken skewers marinated in a tangy sauce, served with a side of portuguese flair.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine jagged tangy sauce ingredients and blend until smooth.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together port wine, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
3. Add the chicken breast to the marinade and mix well.
4. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
6. Thread the chicken breast onto the portuguese skewers.
7. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
8. Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
9. Brush the jagged tangy sauce onto the chicken skewers during the last minute of grilling.
